result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: the bottom navigation is obstructed by a misplaced horizontal bar, and the second restaurant card appears incomplete.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar overlays the bottom navigation, crossing the search and saved icons. It resembles a misplaced gesture indicator or selection marker and makes the controls look broken.
issues.suggestion: Position the system gesture indicator at the true bottom safe area, or correct/remove the navigation selection marker so it does not overlap multiple icons.

issues.description: The second card under “Popular right now” shows only its promotional image; the restaurant name and details are absent despite visible space above the bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card’s title and metadata render directly below the image and add sufficient bottom padding so the fixed navigation cannot obscure them.
